decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is close to the firm's established offer and, with no reported shortfall relative to aspirations, it is kept while performance remains uncertain.
The metropolitan data centre connection network builds on core connectivity capabilities and likely meets aspirations, so it is retained.
Optical spectrum connectivity has its own website page and builds directly on the firm's established offer, indicating strategic commitment and a very low drop likelihood.
The voice number ordering portal supports existing voice services and, absent evidence of a shortfall, organisational slack allows the firm to keep it.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is close to the firm's voice services but may face market decline; however, with no reported shortfall, the firm keeps it for now.
Direct voice network connection service fits the firm's existing capabilities and no performance shortfall is indicated, so it is kept.
